Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human TYK2 (CHEMBL3553) in Homo sapiens. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3553 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
